name: taller-motos
description: MotoPro - Taller de Motos (Frontend + Admin + API)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,admin,api -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,api -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
